name: Patient
definition: A person enrolled in the thrombosis study cohort, recorded once on a summary row in the Patient table with demographics and one aggregated diagnosis string.
scope: Any question that identifies, filters, counts or describes patients.

name: Patient ID
definition: Identifier that uniquely identifies one patient. It is the primary key of the Patient table and the value used to associate Laboratory and Examination rows with a patient.
scope: Patient identification and cross-table association; used by every question that returns or filters on patient identity.

name: Sex
definition: Recorded sex of the patient, held as a single uppercase letter code on the patient record.
scope: Sex-stratified filters and counts over the patient cohort.

name: Birthday
definition: Date of birth of the patient, stored as a text date value on the patient record.
scope: Age computation and birth-year cohort selection.

name: Age
definition: Patient age expressed as whole years, obtained as the difference between the year of the reference date and the year of the patient's birthday.
scope: Age filters and average-age aggregation over the patient cohort; a derived quantity with no dedicated column.

name: Admission Type
definition: Whether the patient was managed as an in-patient or as an out-patient, expressed by a sign code in the Admission column of the patient record.
scope: Comparing in-patient versus out-patient sub-cohorts.

name: Patient Record Description Date
definition: A date carried on the patient summary row that records when that patient's descriptive record was documented. Because it is a date field, the presence or absence of the value is what distinguishes patients whose record was documented from those whose data was not recorded.
scope: Assessing whether a patient's record data was recorded; the field is not a clinical measurement.

name: Laboratory Measurement
definition: One laboratory panel for one patient on one test date. A single row carries many analyte results at once, so it is the measurement event, not an individual analyte.
scope: Laboratory-based cohorts, date-window filtering, and longitudinal per-patient history.

name: Laboratory Test Date
definition: Date on which the laboratory panel was drawn for a patient.
scope: Restricting laboratory findings to a date window and ordering a patient's test history.

name: Laboratory Result
definition: A single measured laboratory quantity belonging to a panel, either numeric (for example albumin, GPT) or a semi-quantitative text code (for example CRP).
scope: Generic discovery entry point for any measured laboratory quantity; specific analytes are subtypes of this concept.

name: Blood Albumin (ALB)
definition: Serum albumin concentration measured in the laboratory panel.
scope: Nutritional and inflammatory status assessment; reported as an average over qualifying laboratory rows.

name: Platelet Count (PLT)
definition: Platelet count measured in the laboratory panel.
scope: Haematological assessment and thrombocytosis/thrombocytopenia filtering.

name: ALT / GPT
definition: Alanine aminotransferase activity, a liver enzyme marker recorded in the laboratory panel.
scope: Liver-injury filtering, including detection of a patient whose enzyme level ever exceeded the reference interval.

name: Blood Glucose (GLU)
definition: Blood glucose concentration measured in the laboratory panel.
scope: Glycaemic status filtering.

name: Total Cholesterol (T-CHO)
definition: Total serum cholesterol measured in the laboratory panel.
scope: Lipid status filtering, including identification of hypercholesterolaemia.

name: Creatinine Phosphokinase (CPK)
definition: Creatine phosphokinase enzyme activity measured in the laboratory panel.
scope: Muscle-damage and myositis assessment.

name: Creatinine (CRE)
definition: Serum creatinine concentration measured in the laboratory panel.
scope: Renal function filtering.

name: Urea Nitrogen (UN)
definition: Blood urea nitrogen concentration measured in the laboratory panel.
scope: Renal function filtering; the workload also refers to a borderline passing value of this analyte.

name: Immunoglobulin G (IGG)
definition: Serum immunoglobulin G concentration measured in the laboratory panel.
scope: Humoral immunity assessment; a substantial minority of laboratory rows leave this analyte unmeasured.

name: Immunoglobulin M (IGM)
definition: Serum immunoglobulin M concentration measured in the laboratory panel.
scope: Humoral immunity assessment and abnormal-immunoglobulin cohort selection.

name: Anti-Cardiolipin Antibody IgM (aCL IgM)
definition: Anti-cardiolipin antibody of the IgM isotype, recorded in the examination record as a numeric level.
scope: Antiphospholipid antibody assessment, evaluated against a cohort average.

name: C-Reactive Protein (CRP)
definition: Acute-phase inflammation marker recorded as a semi-quantitative text code rather than a plain number.
scope: Inflammation filtering and cohorts defined by a positive inflammatory flag.

name: Reference Interval (Normal Range)
definition: The interval of values considered normal for one specific laboratory analyte. It is analytic-specific and is not stored as its own column; each analyte carries its own applicable interval.
scope: Deciding whether a measured value counts as normal; required whenever a question says within, beyond, exceed or abnormal for an analyte.

name: Abnormal Laboratory Result
definition: Status of a laboratory result that falls outside the reference interval of its analyte, whether above, below, or, for semi-quantitative markers, flagged positive.
scope: Cohort definitions phrased as abnormal, not within normal range, beyond the normal range, or exceeding the normal range.

name: Autoantibody Marker
definition: Semi-quantitative antinuclear or autoantibody marker recorded as text, where a negative result is expressed through sentinel codes rather than through a numeric zero.
scope: Autoantibody panels used for connective-tissue-disease classification.

name: Anti-Scl-70 (SC170)
definition: Anti-Scl-70 autoantibody recorded in the laboratory panel, with negativity encoded as a sentinel text value.
scope: Systemic-sclerosis-related autoantibody assessment.

name: Anti-Centromere (CENTROMEA)
definition: Anti-centromere autoantibody recorded in the laboratory panel, with negativity encoded as a sentinel text value.
scope: Limited cutaneous systemic sclerosis assessment.

name: Anti-SSB (SSB)
definition: Anti-SSB (La) autoantibody recorded in the laboratory panel, with negativity encoded as a sentinel text value.
scope: Sjogren-syndrome-related autoantibody assessment.

name: Negative Result Sentinel
definition: Text codes used inside the autoantibody columns to express a negative, seronegative result instead of a measurable titre.
scope: Interpreting normal or negative autoantibody findings; a negative finding must be recognised as a coded value, not as a missing measurement.

name: ANA Titre (ANA)
definition: Antinuclear antibody titre recorded on the examination record as an integer, where zero denotes no detectable titre and positive values are dilution steps.
scope: Antinuclear antibody quantification; distinct from the fluorescence pattern field recorded alongside it.

name: ANA Pattern
definition: Fluorescence staining pattern of the antinuclear antibody test, recorded as one or more letter codes describing the pattern(s) observed.
scope: Pattern-based selection such as a pattern consisting of only one code; separate from the ANA titre column.

name: Degree of Thrombosis
definition: Ordinal grade of thrombotic involvement recorded for an examination, from no involvement up to marked involvement.
scope: Thrombosis-level cohort selection and comparison.

name: Coagulation Assay (KCT / RVVT / LAC)
definition: Panel of three phospholipid-dependent coagulation assays, each recorded as a positive or negative code on the examination record.
scope: Coagulation abnormality assessment; the panel is evaluated as a set of three assays.

name: Positive Degree of Coagulation
definition: Status of a patient or examination for which the coagulation assay panel shows at least one positive result.
scope: Cohort definitions phrased as a positive degree of coagulation or a positive measure of degree of coagulation.
aliases: positive measure of degree of coagulation

name: Recorded Symptoms
definition: Free-text clinical symptom or symptoms recorded for an examination. The field is populated only for examinations that carry a non-zero thrombosis grade, so its presence encodes the occurrence of a thrombotic clinical event.
scope: Filtering patients who did or did not experience recorded symptoms.

name: Diagnosis
definition: Disease or diseases attributed to a patient, recorded in a text field that may hold several comma-separated disease designations at once.
scope: Disease-based cohort selection and disease-frequency aggregation.

name: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE)
definition: Systemic lupus erythematosus, one of the disease designations used in the diagnosis field.
scope: Selecting patients diagnosed with lupus.

name: Sjogren's Syndrome (SjS / SJS)
definition: Sjogren's syndrome, one of the disease designations used in the diagnosis field. Its spelling differs between the two tables that carry a diagnosis.
scope: Selecting patients diagnosed with Sjogren's syndrome.

name: Examination
definition: A clinical examination record for a patient, holding the thrombosis grade, the coagulation assay panel, the antinuclear antibody result and a diagnosis for that encounter.
scope: Questions about thrombosis grading, coagulation positivity, ANA findings or examination-level diagnosis.

name: Examination Date
definition: Date on which an examination record was created for a patient.
scope: Date-restricted examination cohorts.
